steps.name: changed-navigation-only-build-and-sign
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-single-app-XXXXXX)"
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-single-app-sign-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
echo STAGE=TARGETED_QA
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_ux05_locale_accessibility
# Only the Settings navigation changed; release compilation verifies the patch.
echo TARGETED_QA_PASS=true
echo STAGE=BUILD_SIGNED_MAIN_APP
if [[ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" && -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; fi
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
UNSIGNED=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
test -s "$UNSIGNED"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | sort -V | tail -1)"
ZIPALIGN="$(dirname "$SIGNER")/zipalign"
test -x "$SIGNER" && test -x "$ZIPALIGN"
"$ZIPALIGN" -f -p 4 "$UNSIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
SIGNED="$OUT/candidate.apk"
"$SIGNER" sign --ks "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" --ks-key-alias androiddebugkey --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --out "$SIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
"$SIGNER" verify "$SIGNED"
CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$SIGNED" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$CERT" = fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11
echo SIGNED_MAIN_APP_READY=true
umask 077
CACHE="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa/a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
mkdir -p "$CACHE"
cp "$SIGNED" "$CACHE/candidate.apk"
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$SIGNED" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$CACHE/candidate.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo SIGNED_CANDIDATE_RETAINED=true
echo STAGE=EXACT_PHONE_READ_ONLY
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
ROLE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')"
test "$ROLE" = "$PKG"
STATE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
MODE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
test "$STATE" = 0 && test "$MODE" = MODE_NORMAL
PATHS="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$PATHS" | grep -c '^package:')" = 1
REMOTE="$(printf '%s\n' "$PATHS" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$REMOTE" "$OUT/previous.apk" >/dev/null
PREV_CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$OUT/previous.apk" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$PREV_CERT" = "$CERT"
cp "$OUT/previous.apk" "$CACHE/previous.apk"
echo PHONE_IDLE_AND_SIGNER_MATCH=true
echo ROLLBACK_APK_RETAINED=true
echo NO_INSTALL_NO_CALLS=true
echo "QA_SHA=a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"

steps.name: upgrade-existing-main-with-rollback
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
echo "QA_SHA=a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
CACHE="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa/a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"
CANDIDATE="$CACHE/candidate.apk"
PREVIOUS="$CACHE/previous.apk"
test -s "$CANDIDATE" && test -s "$PREVIOUS"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | sort -V | tail -1)"
test -x "$SIGNER"
certificate() { "$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$1" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1; }
CERT="$(certificate "$CANDIDATE")"
test "$CERT" = fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11
test "$(certificate "$PREVIOUS")" = "$CERT"
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
adbq() { adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
phone_idle() {
  local states mode
  states="$(adbq shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | tr -d '\r')"
  mode="$(adbq shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ -n "$states" && -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$states" | grep -v '^0$' || true)" && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL ]]
}
role_ok() { [[ "$(adbq shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')" == "$PKG" ]]; }
package_path() {
  local paths
  paths="$(adbq shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$paths" | grep -c '^package:')" == 1 ]]
  printf '%s\n' "$paths" | sed -n 's/^package://p'
}
host_ready() {
  local response
  response="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$response" == *host_registered=true* ]]
}
start_host() {
  phone_idle && role_ok || return 1
  if host_ready; then return 0; fi
  adbq shell 'APP=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; APK="$(pm path --user 0 "$APP" | sed -n "s/^package://p" | head -n 1)"; test -n "$APK" && test -r "$APK" || exit 7; CLASSPATH="$APK" nohup app_process /system/bin --nice-name=aicalls_gsm_binder pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.session.GsmShellBinderMediaHost pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &' >/dev/null
  for i in {1..25}; do
    if host_ready; then return 0; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-single-upgrade-XXXXXX)"
INSTALLED=0
cleanup() {
  local code=$?
  trap - EXIT
  if [[ "$code" != 0 && "$INSTALLED" == 1 ]]; then
    if phone_idle && role_ok; then
      if adbq install --no-streaming -r "$PREVIOUS" >/dev/null; then
        echo ROLLBACK_APK_RESTORED=true
        if [[ "${HOST_BEFORE:-false}" == true ]]; then start_host && echo ROLLBACK_HOST_RESTORED=true || echo ROLLBACK_HOST_HOLD=true; fi
      else echo ROLLBACK_FAILED=true; fi
    else echo ROLLBACK_DEFERRED_PHONE_NOT_IDLE_OR_ROLE_CHANGED=true; fi
  fi
  rm -rf "$WORK"
  exit "$code"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
test "$(adbq shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" = 16
phone_idle && role_ok || { echo PREFLIGHT_PHONE_NOT_IDLE_OR_ROLE_CHANGED=true; exit 50; }
adbq pull "$(package_path)" "$WORK/current.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$WORK/current.apk" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$PREVIOUS" | awk '{print $1}')" || { echo PREVIOUS_APK_CHANGED_REFUSED=true; exit 51; }
echo EXACT_ROLLBACK_MATCH=true
HOST_BEFORE=false
if host_ready; then HOST_BEFORE=true; fi
echo STAGE=UPGRADE_EXISTING_MAIN_APP
phone_idle && role_ok || exit 52
adbq install --no-streaming -r "$CANDIDATE"
INSTALLED=1
phone_idle && role_ok || exit 53
adbq pull "$(package_path)" "$WORK/installed.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$WORK/installed.apk" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$CANDIDATE" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo MAIN_APP_APK_SHA256_MATCH=true
echo STAGE=RESTORE_EXISTING_GSM_HOST
start_host || { echo MAIN_GSM_HOST_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED=true; exit 54; }
echo MAIN_GSM_HOST_READY=true
echo STAGE=QA_DEFAULT_DENIED
STATUS="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method qa_status)"
[[ "$STATUS" == *armed=false* ]] || { echo QA_NOT_DEFAULT_DISABLED=true; exit 55; }
echo QA_DEFAULT_DISABLED=true
# Read-only check of the fixed endpoint while disarmed, without logging private data.
DENIED="$(adbq shell content read --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder/qa/state 2>&1 || true)"
[[ "$DENIED" == *qa_owner_opt_in_required* || "$DENIED" == *SecurityException* ]] || { echo QA_DISARMED_READ_DENIAL_UNVERIFIED=true; exit 56; }
echo QA_DISARMED_READ_DENIED=true
phone_idle && role_ok && host_ready
INSTALLED=0
echo MAIN_APP_UPGRADED=true
echo PRODUCTION_ROLE_UNCHANGED=true
echo NO_CALLS_NO_DATA_CLEAR=true
echo "QA_SHA=a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b"

steps.name: enable-live-qa-via-existing-ui
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
export QA_USB_SERIAL="$SERIAL"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re, subprocess, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
serial=os.environ["QA_USB_SERIAL"]
pkg="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"
uri="content://"+pkg+".gsmbinder"
def adb(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(["adb","-s",serial,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError("ADB_OPERATION_FAILED")
    return p.stdout
def safe():
    states=re.findall(r"mCallState=(\d+)",adb("shell","dumpsys","telephony.registry"))
    if not states or any(x!="0" for x in states): raise RuntimeError("PHONE_NOT_IDLE")
    if "Actual mode = MODE_NORMAL" not in adb("shell","dumpsys","audio"): raise RuntimeError("AUDIO_NOT_IDLE")
    if adb("shell","cmd","role","get-role-holders","--user","0","android.app.role.DIALER").strip()!=pkg: raise RuntimeError("DIALER_CHANGED")
    if "host_registered=true" not in adb("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","status"): raise RuntimeError("GSM_HOST_UNAVAILABLE")
def armed():
    result=adb("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","qa_status")
    if "armed=true" in result: return True
    if "armed=false" in result: return False
    raise RuntimeError("QA_STATUS_UNKNOWN")
def ui():
    path="/data/local/tmp/aicalls-qa-ui.xml"
    try:
        adb("shell","uiautomator","dump",path)
        return ET.fromstring(adb("exec-out","cat",path))
    finally:
        adb("shell","rm","-f",path)
def click(labels):
    root=ui()
    candidates=[]
    for n in root.iter("node"):
        if n.get("package") not in {pkg,"android"}: continue
        if n.get("enabled")!="true" or n.get("clickable")!="true": continue
        if not ({n.get("text",""),n.get("content-desc","")} & set(labels)): continue
        coords=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",n.get("bounds",""))))
        if len(coords)==4 and coords[2]>coords[0] and coords[3]>coords[1]:
            candidates.append(((coords[0]+coords[2])//2,(coords[1]+coords[3])//2))
    candidates=list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))
    if len(candidates)!=1: return False
    safe()
    adb("shell","input","tap",*map(str,candidates[0]))
    time.sleep(0.7)
    return True
try:
    safe()
    if not armed():
        print("STAGE=OPEN_EXISTING_TEST_LAB",flush=True)
        qa=("QA rozmowy GSM","Live call QA")
        consent=("Włącz nadzór","Enable supervision")
        if not click(qa):
            adb("shell","am","start","-W","-n",pkg+"/.MainActivity")
            time.sleep(1)
            for _ in range(4):
                if click(("Ustawienia","Settings")): break
                time.sleep(1)
            else: raise RuntimeError("SETTINGS_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
            if not click(("Laboratorium offline","Offline laboratory")):
                if not click(("Narzędzia programistyczne","Developer tools")) or not click(("Laboratorium offline","Offline laboratory")):
                    raise RuntimeError("TEST_LAB_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
            if not click(qa): raise RuntimeError("LIVE_QA_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
        print("STAGE=OWNER_AUTHORIZED_ENABLE",flush=True)
        if not click(consent): raise RuntimeError("QA_ENABLE_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
        for _ in range(5):
            if armed(): break
            time.sleep(0.5)
    if not armed(): raise RuntimeError("QA_ENABLE_NOT_CONFIRMED")
    safe()
    print("QA_ARMED=true")
    print("MAIN_GSM_HOST_READY=true")
    print("NO_CALLS=true")
except Exception as e:
    print("HOLD="+str(e) if isinstance(e,RuntimeError) else "HOLD=UI_OR_ADB_ERROR")
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
# One-time local encryption key for staging the user's number and goal without plaintext in Git.
umask 077
KEYDIR="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa/one-time-stage"
mkdir -p "$KEYDIR"
chmod 700 "$KEYDIR"
KEY="$KEYDIR/stage-20261126-v1.pem"
test ! -e "$KEY"
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out "$KEY" 2>/dev/null
chmod 600 "$KEY"
echo STAGE_PUBLIC_KEY_BEGIN
openssl pkey -in "$KEY" -pubout
echo STAGE_PUBLIC_KEY_END
echo PRIVATE_STAGE_KEY_READY=true
